description: This file defines the 'cssMode' module for the Monaco Editor, including various language features such as validation, completion, hover, definition, references, symbol providers, and formatting for CSS. It sets up classes and functions to support language services and integrates with the editor's API.

classes.name: fn
classes.description: Constants for minimum and maximum integer values.

classes.name: E
classes.description: Worker manager class handling language service worker lifecycle, including idle checks and disposal.

classes.name: U
classes.description: Provides hover information in the language service.

classes.name: Z
classes.description: Manages text edits and change annotations.

classes.name: bn
classes.description: Type guard for checking if an object has children.

classes.name: Je
classes.description: Converts a symbol to a simplified object with name, detail, kind, range, etc.

classes.name: Ye
classes.description: Maps internal symbol kinds to language server symbol kinds.
Provides document colors and color presentations.

classes.name: Rn
classes.description: Registers language feature providers based on configuration.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the worker and clears intervals and listeners.

methods.name: _checkIfIdle
methods.description: Checks if the worker has been idle for too long and stops it if so.

methods.name: _getClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the language service worker client.

methods.name: getLanguageServiceWorker
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to the language service worker for given resources.
